description: Na₂O crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.68 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.49 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Na atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Na atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine Na atoms.
